introHtml: LED light school spirit products make your crowd stand out at night games, pep rallies, and parades. From glow-in-the-dark bracelets and necklaces to flashing pins and light-up foam fingers, these items create a unified, visible show of support. Decorate with your school colors and mascot using pad printing or screen printing for a bright, durable finish that lasts all season.
